name: Agnes-2.5-Pro-Alpha
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 45 of 60 layers are linear_attention and 15 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 396.802 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-19.

benchmarks.name: GDPval-AA v2
benchmarks.config: Card HTML benchmark table, column 'Qwen3.5 397B' 23.2 vs 'Agnes 2.5 Pro Alpha' 33.8. Card states every result is an independent Artificial Analysis measurement, snapshot Aug 18 2026. GDPval-AA v2 is AA's normalized score (Elo-500)/2000, not raw accuracy. Card notes it wins 6 of 8 rows and loses tau3-Banking (12.4 vs 13.4) and GPQA Diamond (87.6 vs 89.3).
